6.130 rsMultiStaticCategoriesOrSeries
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsMultiStaticCategoriesOrSeries is a critical error that will occur if a Chart contains multiple instances
of either SeriesGrouping.StaticSeries elements or CategoryGrouping.StaticCategories elements.
